steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish application package naming, metadata identifiers, and application configuration.

steps.title: Define Backend API Schema
steps.description: Create data schema for user career match statistics, tournament trophies, and local run rate logic.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Configure Gradle build setup for Java 8 compatibility and Android SDK 34 target.

steps.title: Setup Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Register game activities, landscape orientation, vibration, and audio settings in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Design Cricket Styling & Color Palette
steps.description: Construct stadium green hues, pitch accents, scoreboard styling, and material themes.

steps.title: Implement Native Audio Synthesizer & SFX Engine
steps.description: Develop zero-latency audio engine generating real-time bat-crack, whoosh, wicket timber, and crowd cheering sound effects.

steps.title: Implement Career Session Manager
steps.description: Create local session persistence for player career runs, high scores, matches played, and sound preferences.

steps.title: Build Generic Backend API Client
steps.description: Build network client with dynamic app_id extraction from assets for player profiles and high scores.

steps.title: Implement Touch Gesture Engine & 3D Batting Mechanics
steps.description: Integrate omni-directional swipe detection, velocity-to-power mapping, lofted trajectory curves, and realistic audio triggers.

steps.title: Enhance Match Controller & Dual-Input HUD
steps.description: Implement interactive sound toggle, swipe trail feedback, on-screen gesture hints, and fallback control pads.

steps.title: Update Main Menu with Sound Settings
steps.description: Add audio preferences and sound toggles directly to lobby cards and settings.

steps.title: Building CricketPro3D
steps.description: Assemble, compile, and finalize the complete 3D Cricket native APK.
